main_body: Fish tank: a wooden-framed glass tank showing water, a fish, plants and sand, drawn face-on
top_band: rows 9-12 brown (#b77246) wooden frame/lid, about 4 rows, then a light-blue glass edge row 13. It reads as the frame's front face, not a horizontal surface; the water is seen face-on with no visible surface or opening.
evidence: The tank is a flat front view. The brown band at the top is a frame bar the same width as the body, and the glass, water, fish, plants and sand are all painted flat on the vertical face. No water surface or opening ellipse is visible from above, and there is no distinct top surface, front-edge line or eave shadow. This is the 'front elevation' and 'rim only' failure from the guide.

style.evidence: The candidate has 23 colours against 38-40 in the references, and 10 colours per tile against 17-20. Flat-fill coverage is 27% against 0-13%. The water is two flat blues with only a few dots, the sand is a simple two-tone pattern, and the frame is a flat brown. Dark edge pixels are 54% neutral, so the outline is partly near-black and the whole reads thinner and more sticker-like than the references' tinted material shading.
